verdict.rationale: Meltano has a public pricing page. The self-hosted option is 'free forever' on your own servers, and the managed offering bills on compute rather than rows, so adding a source does not trigger volume-based charges. That makes costs fairly predictable, but the evidence shows no actual price figures or tiers, and the only estimator is a Fivetran savings comparison rather than a per-source cost tool. Missing for 10: published price figures or tiers for the managed plan, a way to estimate compute cost per new source, independent corroboration of cost predictability.
